title: Lil's earlier marriage to drunken Johnny
summary: Albertson mentions Lil's 1922 marriage to Johnny, whom Hunter remembers as always drunk.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Used to come in there all -- she never did tell us she married. I guess she didn't want us to know, because we used to pan Johnny so. Everytime you would see Lil, here would come Johnny, stiff as a poker, drunk as he could be.
He used to like to drive her car, you know.
I knew him. All the harm he did was to himself, because he was drunk all the time. And how Lil could tolerate him, I don't know. Because she was such a good girl. Lil was a good girl.
